payload.title: CloudWatch operator alerts built for triage
payload.description: Turn CloudWatch alarms and events into operator notifications someone can act on without logging in to AWS: one message per incident, what broke, which site, the impact, the next step, a direct link, acknowledge or mute, one message on clearing. First slice, because this is the problem that started the initiative. Interim: the papyrus-monitoring alarm email stays until this replaces it.
